capabilities: insert game-backlog blocks into notes via the command palette
add and edit game entries through an interactive interface
rate games on a 1-5 scale and mark games as platinum
render game covers from local or remote sources with SteamGridDB support
scan blocks for completed games and show yearly statistics on a profile card
extras: Platform images and the platinum badge are not bundled; a button in the plugin settings downloads them, which is optional but required for the platform image option. The profile card does not auto-update and must be refreshed manually.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track game backlog completions as visual, interactive blocks inside notes.
summary: Interactive widget tracker that logs completed games from a backlog in note blocks, with ratings, covers, profile stats, and grid or table views.
